title: Argilos, irrigated, Moldavian plain, mid-September
rationale: grau_toamna, orz_toamna and rapita_toamna all list argilos in requirements.soil.unsuitable_classes, so none of them may be recommended for this parcel. rapita_toamna is doubly excluded: its 'estul, vestul și nordul țării' window (09-01 → 09-10) closed before the case date. That leaves secara and triticale, neither of which lists argilos as unsuitable — but neither lists it as suitable either, so no ordering between them is asserted, and irrigation removes the drought lever that separates them elsewhere.
